product_family: SEO and content optimization platform with AI-powered content generation, editing, and performance analytics. Single product family without notable sub-products.

privacy.ai_training_note: Clearscope explicitly states that customer inputs do not train their global AI models. From their blog: 'Your inputs don't train a global model. They don't shape anyone else's results.' The company also commits: 'We're not in the business of collecting or reselling data.' Customer uploads (brand voice, content drafts) are used only to inform the individual customer's own work within the Draft with AI feature.
privacy.data_region: United States (Texas-based, likely US data centers via third-party vendors; not explicitly stated)

security.name: Data Protection
security.value: Clearscope states it takes reasonable measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, use, alteration, or destruction. Specific security implementations (encryption, monitoring, etc.) are not detailed in public documentation.

security.name: Data Retention After Deletion
security.value: Customer data is available for 30 days after account cancellation; thereafter, data may be deleted at the company's discretion.

security.name: Third-Party Data Processing
security.value: Data is processed through third-party vendors for hosting, storage, and networking. No vendor list or data processing agreements published publicly.

products.name: Clearscope Core Platform
products.data_scope: Customer content, brand voice, analytics data, user account information
products.notes: All-in-one platform for content discovery, creation, editing, and performance tracking. AI features for content drafting and optimization. Does not train on customer data.
